name: 05-vague-followup
description: COPD exacerbation discharge where every follow-up is underspecified: no owner, no date, 'repeat labs' with no order placed. Faithful extraction means flagging each one as not fully specified and creating chase-down tasks. A dropped task is a major.

input.document:
MERIDIAN HOSPITAL CENTER — Discharge Summary

Pt: Ortiz Rivera, Samuel (goes by Samantha Ortiz)   DOB 01/30/1958   MRN M-556120
Admit 08/09/2026  DC 08/13/2026
Attending: hospitalist service (Dr. on discharge: J. Whitcomb, DO)

DISCHARGE DIAGNOSIS: COPD exacerbation, moderate. GAD. HTN.

COURSE: 68 y/o with COPD (FEV1 48% pred, 2/2026) admitted with increased dyspnea and sputum production after URI. Treated with prednisone burst, azithromycin, duonebs. Weaned to baseline inhalers by day 3. Anxiety prominent during stay, managed with home sertraline and prn support; psych not consulted. O2 sat 93% RA at discharge, at baseline.

DISCHARGE MEDS:
1. Prednisone 40 mg daily x 2 more days, then STOP (last dose 08/15) — NEW, short course
2. Azithromycin 250 mg daily x 1 more day, then STOP (last dose 08/14) — NEW, short course
3. Fluticasone/salmeterol 250/50 1 puff BID — home med, continued
4. Albuterol HFA prn — home med, continued
5. Amlodipine 5 mg daily — home med, continued
6. Sertraline 50 mg daily — home med, continued
7. Atorvastatin 20 mg nightly — home med, continued
8. Multivitamin daily — home med, continued

FOLLOW-UP:
- Follow up with pulmonology.
- Repeat labs when able.
- PCP follow-up recommended.
- Consider outpatient pulmonary rehab referral.

Patient counseled on smoking cessation maintenance (quit 3 months ago, doing well). Return precautions given.

J. Whitcomb DO — 08/13/2026

mustNot: mark any of the four follow-ups fullySpecified — none has an owner, date, or placed order
invent an appointment date or provider the document does not contain
drop the time-boxed prednisone stop date — steroid courses that quietly continue are a known harm
use the member's legal name in any task text — display name is Samantha Ortiz
